landing.heroTitle: Train right, eat well — AI plans both for you
landing.heroCopy: Personalized workout plans based on your body. Vietnamese-friendly meal plans on your budget. Track calories and progress daily — all powered by AI, free to start.
landing.featuresIntro: Built for elite performance. Our AI architecture eliminates friction in your evolution.
landing.formTrackingDesc: Real-time biomechanical analysis. Detect form deviations before they become injuries.
landing.smartFuelingDesc: Budget-aware nutritional engineering based on local inventory.
landing.challengeRewardsDesc: Turn training into a goal-driven loop: join challenges, earn points, and redeem rewards.
landing.intelTitle: From today's data to tomorrow's plan
landing.intelCopy: Viway does more than show metrics. It reads training, nutrition, and progress signals to recommend the next clear action.
landing.intelStepOneDesc: Track form, meals, budget, and activity to build a personal data foundation.
landing.intelStepTwoDesc: Combine goals, body status, inventory, and training history into practical recommendations.
landing.intelStepThreeDesc: Convert analysis into workouts, meals, challenges, and progress signals you can follow.
landing.pricingCopy: Choose the level of AI support you need. Start with basic tracking, then expand into meal planning and advanced analytics.
landing.studentPlanDesc: For beginners who need basic workout and nutrition tracking.
landing.proPlanDesc: For users who want regular AI support across training, nutrition, and progress.
landing.readyCopy: AI-powered meal & workout plans tailored to your body and budget. Start free today — no credit card required.

faq.a1: Yes. The Free plan gives you 25 AI credits per month — enough to generate a weekly workout and meal plan. No credit card required, no auto-charges.
faq.q2: Are meal plans tailored to Vietnamese food?
faq.a2: Absolutely. Viway is built for Vietnamese users — AI recommends familiar dishes like cơm, phở, bún, canh and more. Macros are calculated from real local ingredients.
faq.q3: Can I work out at home without equipment?
faq.a3: Yes. During setup, choose 'home / bodyweight only'. AI generates a programme that fits your space and equipment — from beginner to advanced.
faq.q4: Is my health data kept private?
faq.a4: Your data is encrypted and never sold to third parties. You can delete your account and all data at any time from settings.
faq.q5: Is it safe for complete beginners?
faq.a5: Completely safe. AI analyses your current fitness level, activity, and goals to build a gradual programme — not too hard in week one, not boring after month one.
faq.q6: Does the AI pose camera need special hardware?
faq.a6: No. Any standard phone camera or webcam works. AI analyses 17 body landmarks in real time and prompts you to correct form before injury occurs.
